from pathlib import Path
f=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs/task-884bcfb5.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows/columns are dividers; repeat the nonblank panel pattern.
    bg = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != 4), 0)
    def bands(n, is_divider):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in range(n):
            if is_divider(i):
                if start < i: out.append((start, i))
                start = i + 1
        if start < n: out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rb = bands(h, lambda r: all(v == 4 for v in grid[r]))
    cb = bands(w, lambda c: all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h)))
    panels = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rb for c0,c1 in cb]
    seed = next((p for p in panels if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(p[0],p[1]) for c in range(p[2],p[3]))), None)
    if seed is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = seed
    motif = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in panels:
        if b-a == r1-r0 and y-x == c1-c0:
            for dr in range(b-a): out[a+dr][x:y] = motif[dr][:]
    return out
'''
